ああ、ユーたち！ こんなにも罪深い僕を 信じてくれるのですか？
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, you've finally arrived! Have you decided to trust a sinner like me?

Entry.JapaneseText: うん。全部は信用できないけど ……オレたちはリグナトルに 行かなきゃならないんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah. I can't say I don't have my doubts, but... we need to get to Lignatore Garrison no matter what.

Entry.JapaneseText: 高いとこ怖いけど……お願いします
Entry.EnglishText: It'll be scary being up so high, but... please help us.

Entry.JapaneseText: ハリー アップ！ 急いで飛空船に乗るんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Well then you better hurry now! All aboard!

Entry.JapaneseText: 先刻、闘技場で破壊活動があった。 犯人と思われるソーマ使いどもを 見なかったか？
Entry.EnglishText: We heard reports of some commotion over at the arena. Have you seen any Somatics that may be the culprits?

Entry.JapaneseText: ソーマ使い？ メイビーそれは 僕のライオグランプリ優勝を阻み 屈辱を与えてくれた奴ら……
Entry.EnglishText: Somatics, you say? It's very possible they were the one's who humiliated me and won the Grand Prix.

Entry.JapaneseText: イフ、見かけたら 黙っているはずありませんよ
Entry.EnglishText: If I do see them, I will let you know right away.

Entry.JapaneseText: よし、もし発見したら 軍ではなく教会に知らせよ。 いいな！
Entry.EnglishText: Alright, just make sure you report them to the church and got the military, got it?

Entry.JapaneseText: アーメス……さん。 疑ってごめん。本当に オレたちを助けてくれるんだね
Entry.EnglishText: Ameth, uh sir? I'm sorry for soubting you. But you're really doing us a favor.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふっ……気にしないでください。 さぁ、邪魔が入らないうちに レッツ、出発しましょう！
Entry.EnglishText: Heh... think nothing of it. Come, we best be off before we're caught!

Entry.JapaneseText: 飛空船がなくなってる!?
Entry.EnglishText: Where's the airship?!

Entry.JapaneseText: あなた、飛空船の船員ね。 飛空船は、いつ戻ってくるの？
Entry.EnglishText: You're an airship pilot, right? Can you tell us when the airship should return?

Entry.JapaneseText: うぃぃ……ひっく…… ……もうここにゃあ 戻ってこねぇよぉ……
Entry.EnglishText: Ugh... *hic*... it ain't ever comin' back...

Entry.JapaneseText: オーナーのアーメスが 売っ払っちまったんだぁ〜 ……で、俺もめでたくお払い箱よ
Entry.EnglishText: The owner Ameth went and sold it... and now WE'RE outta a job.

Entry.JapaneseText: まぁ、世界が本当に滅ぶなら どうでもいい事だがなぁ〜……
Entry.EnglishText: Well, if the world really IS goin' to hell who gives a damn...?

Entry.JapaneseText: どこに売られたかわかりませんか？ あの飛空船がどうしても 必要なのです
Entry.EnglishText: Do you know who he sold it to? We are in desperate need of that airship.

Entry.JapaneseText: あぁん、お前は…………？
Entry.EnglishText: The hell are you...?

Entry.JapaneseText: ひ、飛空船の行方なら アーメスが知ってるぜ
Entry.EnglishText: A-Ameth should know where the airship's goin'.

Entry.JapaneseText: 奴なら、ホテル地下の カジノで呑んだくれてるはずだ
Entry.EnglishText: He's probably off drinkin' in the hotel casino.

Entry.JapaneseText: ご親切にありがとうございます。 訪ねてみますわ
Entry.EnglishText: Thank you very much. We'll pay him a visit.

Entry.JapaneseText: こんな時にカジノで 呑んだくれてるなんて…… オレたちに負けたショックかな？
Entry.EnglishText: I can't believe he's getting drunk at a casino at a time like this... do you think the shock of losing got to him?

Entry.JapaneseText: あの変人野郎が、そんなタマかよ
Entry.EnglishText: Are you REALLY surprised? The guy's a total nutcase.

Entry.JapaneseText: おや、ユーたち。 こんなところで 何をドゥしてるんだい？

Entry.JapaneseText: ここのバトルは命がけだぜ？
Entry.EnglishText: This is a battle to the death, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場に挑戦できるのは 腕に覚えのある猛者だけだ

Entry.JapaneseText: くっ、どうしても勝ち抜けねぇ……

Entry.JapaneseText: ……俺はここまでの男なのか!?

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場の参加者たちで街の 自警団をつくったんだ

Entry.JapaneseText: アーメスと協力して ユーライオを守るぜ!!
Entry.EnglishText: With Ameth's help, we'll protect our city!

Entry.JapaneseText: ここが、なんとかグランプリの 予選会場か……

Entry.JapaneseText: 勇者になんて興味はねぇが 急に参加したくなっちまったぜっ!!

Entry.JapaneseText: もう勇者には興味はねぇが この街にとどまりたく なっちまったぜ……

Entry.EnglishText: Popcorn, get your popcorn!

Entry.JapaneseText: やめられない！ とまらない！ キャラメルをたぁ〜っぷりかけた ポップコーンをどうぞ♪
Entry.EnglishText: You know you want some! Come try and delicious caramel corn! ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: ふん、どいつもこいつも 勇者勇者と浮かれおって……
Entry.EnglishText: Hmph, everyone's always “champ this” and “champ that”...

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界勇者はこのワシに 決まっておるだろうがーーーッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: But the one taking home title of champion is ME!!!

Entry.JapaneseText: 飛空船に乗ったコトは あるかい？
Entry.EnglishText: You ever been on an airship?

Entry.JapaneseText: 飛空船を危険で 役立たずだと言う者も多いが ワシは素晴らしい発明だと思うな
Entry.EnglishText: Many think they're dangerous or useless, but I think they're brilliant bit of engineering!

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界のあちこちで 空飛ぶクジラが 目撃されているらしい
Entry.EnglishText: Sounds like people all over the world has seen a whale flying through the sky.

Entry.JapaneseText: 飛空船を使えば、空飛ぶクジラを 捕まえられるかも知れんな……
Entry.EnglishText: If we take an airship, maybe we could catch the whale...

Entry.JapaneseText: 怪物から街を守るアーメスを見て ワシは決めたよ
Entry.EnglishText: After seeing how hard Ameth fought to protect the city, I made up my mind...

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界が落ち着いたら、飛空船を 改良する資金を出してやろうとな
Entry.EnglishText: Once the world calms down again, I'm gonna help fund the repair of his airship.

Entry.JapaneseText: 一見軽すぎだが、なかなか根性の ある奴だ。奴と同じ夢を追いかけて みたくなったんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: He may seem kinda aloof at first glance, but the guy's got guts. I want to chase his dream alongside him.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは飛空船の発着所だよ
Entry.EnglishText: This is the airship landing zone.

Entry.JapaneseText: 信じられるかい？ 飛空船って空飛ぶ船なんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Can you even believe that an airship is able to fly?

Entry.JapaneseText: アーメスって奴が 飛空船の今のオーナーなんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Ameth is the current owner of the airship.

Entry.JapaneseText: 前のオーナーは、飛空船の 墜落事故で亡くなったそうだよ……
Entry.EnglishText: The previous owner died in a crash...

Entry.JapaneseText: 人間が空を飛ぼうなんて やっぱり無理があるよねぇ？
Entry.EnglishText: Don't you think humans aren't meant to fly in the air?

Entry.JapaneseText: 空飛ぶクジラを見たって？ ……冗談だろ!?
Entry.EnglishText: You saw a whale fly through the sky? You are kidding, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: みんな、もっと現実に 目を向けろよ
Entry.EnglishText: Please, face reality a little.

Entry.JapaneseText: 空飛ぶクジラに、夢を喰う魔物に 黒い月のバケモノ……
Entry.EnglishText: The flying whale, the monsters that eat your dreams, the Ebony Moon being a giant monster...

Entry.JapaneseText: うぅ〜ん…… こんな現実的からは 目をそらしたいよ……
Entry.EnglishText: Ugh... I just want to turn my eye away from this reality...

Entry.JapaneseText: し、辛抱しなきゃ……
Entry.EnglishText: I-I need to hold out...

Entry.JapaneseText: このカウンターを飛び越えて ライオグランプリに参加しちゃ ダメよ、私ぃぃっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Ooh, I wish I could just leap right over the counter and enter the Grand Prix myself!

Entry.JapaneseText: この上が飛空船の発着所です
Entry.EnglishText: Above here is the airship landing zone.

Entry.JapaneseText: 飛空船発着所からは 天気がよければ キングクロスの塔が見えますよ
Entry.EnglishText: When the weather's clear, you can see King's Cross from up there.

Entry.JapaneseText: お客さんが少なくて、退屈……
Entry.EnglishText: Ugh, there's no customers and I'm sooo bored...

Entry.JapaneseText: 転職を考えよっかなぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe I should get a different job...

Entry.JapaneseText: 転職なんてしないわっ！
Entry.EnglishText: No, I can't do that!

Entry.JapaneseText: やっぱり私、お客さんの 笑顔が大好きなんだもの！
Entry.EnglishText: I just love seeing our customer's smiling faces!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……なんて カッコつけすぎかしら♪
Entry.EnglishText: ...Hehe, just wanted to sound cool! ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: 少年の夢はとめられないよっ
Entry.EnglishText: There's no stopping a kid like me when it comes to his dreams.

Entry.JapaneseText: おれっちは 世界Ｎｏ．１勇者になる!!
Entry.EnglishText: I'm gonna be a hero, just like my dad!

Entry.JapaneseText: …………ここを動きたくない。 いや、動けないんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: I don't wanna move from here. I refuse!

Entry.JapaneseText: だって………… ……見えるんだもん∀
Entry.EnglishText: I have a perfect view from here. ∀

Entry.JapaneseText: もう、おれっち ここに住みたいよ！
Entry.EnglishText: I wanna camp out here forever!

Entry.JapaneseText: ここが、おれっちの ベストプレイスなんだ!!
Entry.EnglishText: This is my favorite place to be!

Entry.JapaneseText: 黒い月ガルデニア……
Entry.EnglishText: The Ebony Moon, Gardenia...

Entry.JapaneseText: そして……白い…………
Entry.EnglishText: And the Ivory...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……白い月だよっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: The Ivory Moon!

Entry.JapaneseText: おれっちは 月を見てただけだってばぁ!?
Entry.EnglishText: I was just looking at the moon, okay?!

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦いの時は来た…… わたしも戦わなきゃ!!
Entry.EnglishText: The time to fight has come. I'll be joining the battle, of course!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……なぜかしら？
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder why?

Entry.JapaneseText: 誰かがわたしを 見てるような気がする……
Entry.EnglishText: I feel as if somebody's watching me...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……なぜかしら？
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder why?

Entry.JapaneseText: 仁王立ちしてみたい気分……
Entry.EnglishText: I almost want to make a scary pose...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……あなたは、もしかして……
Entry.EnglishText: Wait, don't tell me...

Entry.JapaneseText: 下から覗いてたでしょっ!? このケダモノぉぉぉっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: You've been peeking up my skirt from below?! You're disgusting!

Entry.JapaneseText: 商人仲間がユーライオに 向かったまま帰らないんだ……
Entry.EnglishText: My fellow merchants left Couraleo and never returned...

Entry.JapaneseText: だが、捜しに来てわかった……
Entry.EnglishText: But I came here looking for them, and this is what I find...

Entry.JapaneseText: ライオグランプリに出場する ためなら、仕方ないよなっ！ 俺も、やつと一緒に参加するぜ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I can't pass up a chance like this, I GOTTA participate in the Grand Prix! I'll be seeing you in the ring!

Entry.JapaneseText: グランプリは、俺も仲間も 予選落ちだったぜ…… そりゃそうだよなぁ？
Entry.EnglishText: Me and my friends didn't make into the competition... I mean, of course we didn't!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんで商人の俺たちが 参戦しようなんて 思っちまったのかなぁ……??
Entry.EnglishText: We're merchants for crying out loud! What were we thinking entering a battle tournament...?

Entry.JapaneseText: 俺も、夢を喰う魔物に出会ったが 奴らの強さは異常だ
Entry.EnglishText: I came across one of those dream-eating monsters, and boy are they something fierce.

Entry.JapaneseText: あんな化物がそこら中に あふれているんだ。 旅するのは命がけだぞ……
Entry.EnglishText: Apparently they're everywhere. They sure make traveling risky business...

Entry.JapaneseText: へへ、こんな時こそ 旅商人が活躍しなきゃな！
Entry.EnglishText: Hehe, that's EXACTLY why we need traveling merchants like myself!

Entry.JapaneseText: 命をかけて 物資を届けてやるぜ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'll put my life on the line to deliver your supplies!

Entry.JapaneseText: ウワーーン！ ビェーン！
Entry.EnglishText: Hooray! Bravo!

Entry.JapaneseText: あぁ！ 分からない！ 誰か教えて欲ください！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, I just don't know! Somebody, tell me!

Entry.JapaneseText: どちら派？ の男
やっぱりイヌこそ 人間の永遠の友ですよね♪
Entry.EnglishText: Dogs really are man's best friend, after all! ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: どちら派？ の男
やっぱりネコのかわいさは 最強ですよね∀
Entry.EnglishText: Cats really are the cutest things alive, after all! ∀
